besluite.fout: 'voor die mense gevlieg' can be read as 'flew in front of the people', and a crowd did watch, so a Grade 4 reader can take the wrong sense.
besluite.rede: 'nog voor' fixes the time sense (the animals flew before any person did) without changing who flew or when.

besluite.fout: 'massief' in Afrikaans means solid, which misdescribes a fabric covering; 'huge' is an English-led sense.
besluite.rede: 'yslike' gives the intended size plainly and leaves the protected word 'omhulsel' intact.
'Een vlam naby' is natural Afrikaans already, so the proposal is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: The lesson keeps calling the airship 'die skip', so 'die reis met 'n skip' can be read as the airship itself.
besluite.rede: 'op die see' makes clear a sea ship is meant, fixing the reference without adding a fact.
'was die hele groot skip in vlamme' is ordinary, correct Afrikaans that an editor would let pass; the idiom swap is only different.

besluite.fout: 'in die ramp gesterf' is stiffer than the verb Afrikaans normally uses for dying in a disaster.
besluite.rede: 'omgekom' is the natural verb here, the meaning is unchanged, and the protected numbers stay untouched.

besluite.fout: The relative clause 'wat deur enjins gestoot word' can attach to 'gas' instead of the vessel.
besluite.rede: The ambiguity is real, but this is a shared glossary definition reworded beyond grammar, so only the writer may change it.
